blocks.text: Inkor gap: bitta qoida, barcha zamonlar

O'zbek tilida inkor fe'lning o'ziga qo'shiladi: bor**ma**yman, bor**ma**di, bor**ma**gan; ot va sifat bilan esa **emas** yoki **yo'q** keladi. Ingliz tilida asosiy fe'l o'zgarmaydi — **not** so'zi **yordamchi fe'ldan keyin** qo'yiladi: She **is not** here. They **have not** finished. Shuning uchun inkor tuzishdan oldin gapdagi yordamchi fe'lni topish kerak. Bu dars 1–39-darslarda alohida o'tilgan inkor shakllarini bitta tizimga yig'adi.

So'zlashuvda deyarli doim qisqa shakl ishlatiladi: `n't` = not. Ba'zi shakllarni alohida yodlang: will not → **won't**, can not → **cannot** (bitta so'z bo'lib yoziladi) → **can't**. **I am not** ning qisqa shakli bitta: **I'm not** («I amn't» yo'q). is / are bilan ikki xil qisqa shakl bor: he **isn't** = he**'s not**, we **aren't** = we**'re not** — ma'nosi bir xil, ikkinchisida not ga urg'u tushadi.

items.text: You **mustn't** use your phone during the exam.

blocks.text: Yordamchi fe'l ko'rinmasa: don't, doesn't, didn't

Present Simple va Past Simple darak gapida yordamchi fe'l ko'rinmaydi: I **like**, she **works**, we **went**. Inkorda u paydo bo'ladi: **do / does** (hozirgi zamon) yoki **did** (o'tgan zamon) + not. Asosiy fe'l esa **asosiy shaklga** qaytadi, chunki zamon va shaxs belgisi (`-s`, `-ed`, went) endi yordamchi fe'lga o'tadi: She work**s** → She doe**s**n't **work**. We **went** → We **did**n't **go**. Bir gapda zamon belgisi faqat bir marta bo'ladi (→ 6-dars, 12-dars).

items.text: We **didn't buy** anything at the market.
James **doesn't speak** Uzbek, but he understands a little.

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «I not understand.» / «I no understand.» → **I don't understand.** (yordamchi fe'lsiz not qo'yilmaydi); «She don't know.» → **She doesn't know.**; «He doesn't knows.» → **He doesn't know.**; «I didn't went.» → **I didn't go.**; «I am not agree.» → **I don't agree.** (agree — oddiy fe'l, unga be qo'shilmaydi).
Bir nechta yordamchi fe'l: not birinchisidan keyin

Ba'zi fe'l shakllarida ikki-uch yordamchi fe'l bo'ladi: has been working, will be working, is being repaired, has been sold. Bunday holatda **not** faqat **birinchi** yordamchi fe'ldan keyin keladi va qisqa shakl ham unga qo'shiladi: The car **hasn't** been sold. I **won't** be working tomorrow. The road **isn't** being repaired. Majhul nisbat haqida — → 21–22-darslar.

items.text: I **won't be** using the car this weekend.

blocks.text: O'zbekchada ikki inkor odatiy: «Hech narsa **bilmayman**», «Hech qachon **chekmaganman**». Ingliz tilida esa gapda **bitta** inkor bo'ladi. **never**, **nobody**, **nothing** o'zi inkor — ular bilan fe'l darak shaklda qoladi: I **never** smoke («I never don't smoke» emas). I know **nothing** = I **don't** know **anything** («I don't know nothing» emas). Batafsil — → 77–78-darslar.

Bog'liq darslar: inkor buyruq (Don't touch it!) — → 35-dars; have got inkori (I haven't got = I don't have) — → 9-dars; inkor savollar (Why didn't you ...? Isn't it ...?) — → 44-dars; I don't, but she does — → 40-dars.

Inkor tuzishning uch qadami: 1) gapdagi **birinchi** yordamchi fe'lni toping (am, is, was, have, will, can ...); 2) undan keyin **not** / `n't` qo'ying; 3) yordamchi fe'l yo'q bo'lsa — **don't / doesn't / didn't** qo'shing va asosiy fe'lni asosiy shaklga qaytaring.

items: **not** yordamchi fe'ldan keyin keladi: isn't, wasn't, haven't, won't, can't, shouldn't.
Yordamchi fe'l bo'lmasa: **don't / doesn't / didn't** + asosiy shakl (doesn't **work**, didn't **go**).
Bir nechta yordamchi fe'l bo'lsa — **not** birinchisidan keyin: hasn't been done, won't be working.
Gapda bitta inkor: I **never** smoke. / I **don't** know anything.

examples.title: **isn't**, **aren't**, **wasn't**, **weren't**
examples.description: **be** bilan inkor: am / is / are / was / were dan keyin **not**. Present Continuous va majhul nisbatda ham shunday: isn't working, wasn't built.

sentences.text: The lift **isn't** working again, so we'll have to take the stairs.
sentences.translation: Lift yana **ishlamayapti**, zinadan chiqishga to'g'ri keladi.

sentences.text: **I'm not** a tourist — I live here.
sentences.translation: Men sayyoh **emasman** — shu yerda yashayman.

sentences.text: My grandparents **weren't** at home when we arrived.
sentences.translation: Biz kelganimizda bobo-buvim uyda **yo'q edi**.

sentences.text: It **wasn't** a bad film, but it was too long.
sentences.translation: Film yomon **emasdi**, lekin juda uzun edi.

sentences.text: Sorry, Mr Brown **isn't** in the office at the moment.
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, janob Braun hozir ofisda **emaslar**.

sentences.text: These tomatoes **aren't** from the market — they're from our garden.
sentences.translation: Bu pomidorlar bozordan **emas** — bog'imizdan.

sentences.text: Why **aren't** you wearing a coat? It's freezing!
sentences.translation: Nega palto **kiymay** yuribsiz? Havo muzlatyapti-ku!

sentences.text: Dilnoza **wasn't** feeling well, so she stayed at home.
sentences.translation: Dilnozaning **tobi yo'q edi**, shuning uchun uyda qoldi.

sentences.text: The museum **wasn't** built in the nineteenth century — it's much older.
sentences.translation: Muzey o'n to'qqizinchi asrda **qurilmagan** — u ancha qadimiyroq.

sentences.text: We **aren't** going anywhere this summer because we're saving money.
sentences.translation: Bu yoz hech qayerga **bormaymiz**, chunki pul yig'yapmiz.

examples.title: **don't** / **doesn't**: Present Simple
examples.description: Present Simple inkori: **don't / doesn't** + fe'lning asosiy shakli. he / she / it bilan **doesn't**, asosiy fe'l esa `-s` siz: doesn't **work**.

sentences.text: I **don't** drink coffee in the evening.
sentences.translation: Kechqurun qahva **ichmayman**.

sentences.text: Aziz **doesn't** work on Fridays.
sentences.translation: Aziz juma kunlari **ishlamaydi**.

sentences.text: My children **don't** watch much television.
sentences.translation: Bolalarim televizorni ko'p **ko'rishmaydi**.

sentences.text: This shop **doesn't** sell newspapers any more.
sentences.translation: Bu do'kon endi gazeta **sotmaydi**.

sentences.text: Sarah **doesn't** live in London — she lives in a small town near Oxford.
sentences.translation: Sara Londonda **yashamaydi** — u Oksford yaqinidagi kichik shaharchada yashaydi.

sentences.text: We **don't** need a taxi. The station is only five minutes away.
sentences.translation: Bizga taksi **kerak emas**. Vokzal bor-yo'g'i besh daqiqalik yo'l.

sentences.text: It **doesn't** snow much in Tashkent, but it gets very cold.
sentences.translation: Toshkentda qor ko'p **yog'maydi**, lekin havo juda sovuq bo'ladi.

sentences.text: My grandmother **doesn't** understand English, so please speak Uzbek.
sentences.translation: Buvim inglizchani **tushunmaydi**, iltimos, o'zbekcha gapiring.

sentences.text: Bekzod is a vegetarian, so he **doesn't** eat meat or fish.
sentences.translation: Bekzod vegetarian, shuning uchun go'sht ham, baliq ham **yemaydi**.

sentences.text: These shoes look nice, but they **don't** fit me.
sentences.translation: Bu tufli chiroyli ko'rinadi, lekin oyog'imga **to'g'ri kelmaydi**.

examples.title: **didn't**: Past Simple
examples.description: Past Simple inkori: **didn't** + fe'lning asosiy shakli (didn't **go**, didn't **see** — «didn't went» emas). Barcha shaxslar uchun bitta shakl.

sentences.text: I **didn't** sleep much on the plane to London.
sentences.translation: Londonga uchayotganda samolyotda deyarli **uxlamadim**.

sentences.text: We **didn't** go out because it was raining.
sentences.translation: Yomg'ir yog'ayotgani uchun tashqariga **chiqmadik**.

sentences.text: Madina **didn't** call me back yesterday.
sentences.translation: Kecha Madina menga qayta **qo'ng'iroq qilmadi**.

sentences.text: The driver **didn't** stop at our bus stop, so we had to walk back.
sentences.translation: Haydovchi bizning bekatimizda **to'xtamadi**, shuning uchun orqaga piyoda qaytishga to'g'ri keldi.

sentences.text: Sorry, I **didn't** hear you. Could you say that again?
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, sizni **eshitmadim**. Yana bir bor ayta olasizmi?

sentences.text: Tom **didn't** have breakfast this morning, so he's very hungry now.
sentences.translation: Tom bugun ertalab **nonushta qilmadi**, shuning uchun hozir qorni juda och.

sentences.text: My parents **didn't** have a car when I was a child.
sentences.translation: Bolaligimda ota-onamning mashinasi **yo'q edi**.

sentences.text: The film **didn't** start on time — we waited for twenty minutes.
sentences.translation: Film o'z vaqtida **boshlanmadi** — yigirma daqiqa kutdik.

sentences.text: Emma **didn't** know anybody at the party, but she had a great time.
sentences.translation: Emma ziyofatda hech kimni **tanimasdi**, lekin juda yaxshi vaqt o'tkazdi.

sentences.text: Why **didn't** you tell me about the exam? I **didn't** know anything!
sentences.translation: Nega menga imtihon haqida **aytmadingiz**? Men hech narsa **bilmasdim**!

examples.title: **haven't** / **hasn't**: Present Perfect
examples.description: Present Perfect inkori: **haven't / hasn't** + V3. **never** bilan esa fe'l darak shaklda qoladi: has **never** used (bitta inkor).

sentences.text: I **haven't** seen Bekzod for a long time.
sentences.translation: Bekzodni ancha vaqtdan beri **ko'rmadim**.

sentences.text: Madina **hasn't** finished her dinner yet.
sentences.translation: Madina hali kechki ovqatini **tugatmadi**.

sentences.text: We **haven't** been to the new shopping centre.
sentences.translation: Biz yangi savdo markazida **bo'lmaganmiz**.

sentences.text: Tom **hasn't** got any brothers or sisters.
sentences.translation: Tomning aka-ukasi ham, opa-singlisi ham **yo'q**.

sentences.text: The guests **haven't** arrived yet, so we can relax for a few minutes.
sentences.translation: Mehmonlar hali **kelishmadi**, shuning uchun bir necha daqiqa dam olsak bo'ladi.

sentences.text: It **hasn't** rained here since April, and the garden is very dry.
sentences.translation: Bu yerda apreldan beri yomg'ir **yog'magan**, bog' juda qurib qolgan.

sentences.text: Sorry, I **haven't** read your email yet. I'll do it now.
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, xatingizni hali **o'qimadim**. Hozir o'qiyman.

sentences.text: My grandfather **has never** used a computer, but he wants to learn.
sentences.translation: Bobom hech qachon kompyuterdan **foydalanmagan**, lekin o'rganmoqchi.

sentences.text: Aziz **hasn't** been well this week, so he isn't coming to the match.
sentences.translation: Azizning bu hafta **tobi bo'lmadi**, shuning uchun o'yinga kelmaydi.

sentences.text: Have you seen my keys? — No, I **haven't**. Look in your coat.
sentences.translation: Kalitlarimni ko'rdingizmi? — Yo'q, **ko'rmadim**. Paltongizni qarang.

examples.title: **can't**, **won't**, **shouldn't**, **mustn't**
examples.description: Modal fe'llar inkori: modaldan keyin **not**, asosiy fe'l asosiy shaklda: can't **find**, won't **tell**. will not → **won't**, mustn't — taqiq, shouldn't — maslahat.

sentences.text: I **can't** find my phone anywhere.
sentences.translation: Telefonimni hech qayerdan **topolmayapman**.

sentences.text: Don't worry, I **won't** tell anybody your secret.
sentences.translation: Xavotir olmang, siringizni hech kimga **aytmayman**.

sentences.text: You **shouldn't** drive when you're tired.
sentences.translation: Charchaganingizda mashina **haydamasligingiz kerak**.

sentences.text: Passengers **mustn't** smoke on the train.
sentences.translation: Yo'lovchilar poyezdda **chekishi mumkin emas**.

sentences.text: Bekzod **couldn't** come to the wedding because he was in Moscow.
sentences.translation: Bekzod to'yga **kela olmadi**, chunki Moskvada edi.

sentences.text: It **won't** be easy, but I'm sure you'll pass the exam.
sentences.translation: Oson **bo'lmaydi**, lekin imtihondan o'tishingizga ishonaman.

sentences.text: My little sister **can't** ride a bike yet.
sentences.translation: Singlim hali velosiped **hayday olmaydi**.

sentences.text: We **might not** go to Samarkand this year — we haven't got enough money.
sentences.translation: Bu yil Samarqandga **bormasligimiz mumkin** — pulimiz yetarli emas.

sentences.text: Dilnoza **wouldn't** like a big party — she prefers a quiet dinner.
sentences.translation: Dilnozaga katta ziyofat **yoqmasdi** — u tinch kechki ovqatni afzal ko'radi.

sentences.text: Children **shouldn't** eat so many sweets, and they **mustn't** play near the road.
sentences.translation: Bolalar shuncha ko'p shirinlik **yemasligi kerak**, yo'l yaqinida esa **o'ynashi mumkin emas**.

examples.title: Positive ↔ negative: correcting facts
examples.description: Inkor va darak yonma-yon — noto'g'ri fikrni tuzatish. Har bir zamonda inkor o'z yordamchi fe'li bilan: isn't / doesn't / didn't / haven't / can't / won't.

sentences.text: Bekzod **doesn't** work in a bank — he **works** in a hotel.
sentences.translation: Bekzod bankda **ishlamaydi** — u mehmonxonada **ishlaydi**.

sentences.text: We **didn't** fly to Manchester — we **took** the train from London.
sentences.translation: Manchesterga samolyotda **uchmadik** — Londondan poyezdda **bordik**.

sentences.text: The concert **isn't** on Saturday, it**'s** on Sunday.
sentences.translation: Konsert shanba kuni **emas**, yakshanba **kuni**.

sentences.text: I **haven't** lost my passport — I**'ve** just found it in my bag!
sentences.translation: Pasportimni **yo'qotmabman** — hozirgina sumkamdan **topdim**!

sentences.text: Madina **can't** speak Chinese, but she **can** speak Korean.
sentences.translation: Madina xitoycha gapira **olmaydi**, lekin koreyscha gapira **oladi**.

sentences.text: It **wasn't** my idea to come here. It **was** yours!
sentences.translation: Bu yerga kelish mening fikrim **emasdi**. Sizniki **edi**!

sentences.text: Tom **won't** be here on Monday, but he**'ll** come on Tuesday.
sentences.translation: Tom dushanba kuni bu yerda **bo'lmaydi**, lekin seshanba kuni **keladi**.

sentences.text: My parents **don't** live in the city centre. They **live** near the airport.
sentences.translation: Ota-onam shahar markazida **yashamaydi**. Ular aeroport yaqinida **yashashadi**.

sentences.text: Sorry, I **didn't** mean to wake you. I **thought** you were awake.
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, sizni uyg'otmoqchi **emasdim**. Uyg'oqsiz deb **o'ylabman**.

sentences.text: The children **aren't** sleeping — they**'re** playing computer games under the blanket!
sentences.translation: Bolalar **uxlamayapti** — ular adyol ostida kompyuter o'yini **o'ynayapti**!

examples.title: **not** after the first auxiliary: **hasn't been**
examples.description: Fe'l shaklida bir nechta yordamchi fe'l bo'lsa, **not** birinchisidan keyin keladi: has **not** been, will **not** be, is **not** being. Majhul nisbat va davomli shakllarda ham shunday.

sentences.text: The new hospital **hasn't been** finished yet.
sentences.translation: Yangi shifoxona hali **qurib bitkazilmagan**.

sentences.text: I **won't be** working tomorrow, so we can meet in the morning.
sentences.translation: Ertaga **ishlamayman**, shuning uchun ertalab uchrashsak bo'ladi.

sentences.text: The road **isn't being** repaired at the moment — the workers are on holiday.
sentences.translation: Hozir yo'l **ta'mirlanmayapti** — ishchilar ta'tilda.

sentences.text: Aziz **hasn't been** sleeping well since he started his new job.
sentences.translation: Yangi ishni boshlaganidan beri Aziz yaxshi **uxlamayapti**.

sentences.text: Yesterday the letters **weren't** sent because the post office was closed.
sentences.translation: Kecha xatlar **jo'natilmadi**, chunki pochta yopiq edi.

sentences.text: We **haven't been** invited to the wedding — maybe they forgot about us.
sentences.translation: Bizni to'yga **taklif qilishmagan** — balki unutib qo'yishgandir.

sentences.text: Sarah **wasn't** told about the change, so she came at the old time.
sentences.translation: Saraga o'zgarish haqida **aytilmagan edi**, shuning uchun u eski vaqtda keldi.

sentences.text: This room **hasn't been** cleaned for weeks!
sentences.translation: Bu xona bir necha haftadan beri **tozalanmagan**!

sentences.text: The match **won't be** shown on TV, so we're going to the stadium.
sentences.translation: O'yin televizorda **ko'rsatilmaydi**, shuning uchun stadionga boramiz.

sentences.text: Bekzod **hasn't been** answering his phone all day. I'm getting worried.
sentences.translation: Bekzod kun bo'yi telefonini **ko'tarmayapti**. Xavotirlana boshladim.

examples.title: Mixed practice: a terrible holiday
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: omadsiz ta'til haqida hikoya, barcha zamonlarda inkor. Har bir gapda o'zingizdan so'rang: yordamchi fe'l qaysi? Yo'q bo'lsa — do / does / did.

sentences.text: Our hotel **wasn't** near the beach, as the website said.
sentences.translation: Mehmonxonamiz saytda yozilganidek sohil yaqinida **emasdi**.

sentences.text: The air conditioning in our room **didn't** work at all.
sentences.translation: Xonamizdagi konditsioner umuman **ishlamadi**.

sentences.text: The staff **weren't** very helpful, and they **didn't** speak much English.
sentences.translation: Xodimlar unchalik **yordam bermasdi**, inglizchani ham yaxshi **bilishmasdi**.

sentences.text: We **couldn't** sleep because of the noise from the street.
sentences.translation: Ko'chadan keladigan shovqin tufayli **uxlay olmadik**.

sentences.text: It rained every day, so the children **didn't** swim even once.
sentences.translation: Har kuni yomg'ir yog'di, shuning uchun bolalar bir marta ham **cho'milishmadi**.

sentences.text: My husband **hasn't** stopped complaining since we got home.
sentences.translation: Uyga qaytganimizdan beri erim **shikoyat qilishdan to'xtamadi**.

sentences.text: I **don't** think we'll go back there again.
sentences.translation: Menimcha, u yerga boshqa **bormaymiz**.

sentences.text: Why **didn't** you read the reviews before you booked? — I **didn't** have time.
sentences.translation: Bron qilishdan oldin nega sharhlarni **o'qimadingiz**? — **Vaqtim bo'lmadi**.

sentences.text: Next year we **won't** choose a cheap package holiday — we'll stay in Uzbekistan!
sentences.translation: Kelasi yili arzon tur paketini **tanlamaymiz** — O'zbekistonda dam olamiz!

sentences.text: The trip **wasn't** a complete disaster, though: the food **wasn't** bad.
sentences.translation: Shunday bo'lsa-da, safar butunlay falokat **emasdi**: ovqat **yomon emasdi**.
